_comment: `app.js` contains `export * from 'ext'` with `ext` external, so part of its export interface only exists at runtime. Pins that those names stay observable through `import('./app.js')`, and how many chunks the shape currently produces. The entry's own direct external stars stay inside its materialized namespace as runtime `__reExport` merges, so those names remain observable while `shared.js` is inlined.
